pages.text: On Gallifrey the Time Lords built trial chambers of their own, in white quartz, bronze and roundels. Their spawners send $(thing)Daleks$(), $(thing)Cybermen$() and $(thing)Cybermats$() instead of zombies and skeletons. The waves are smaller, but every enemy is far tougher.

$(item)Gallifreyan Vaults$() only open for $(item)Gallifreyan Trial Keys$(), which you earn from these spawners. Inside are the usual rewards plus Time Lord technology: sonic crystals, an atrium core, circuits and more. Ominous ones can even give a $(item)Vortex Manipulator$().
Trial Omen works here too. Ominous Gallifreyan spawners call in the Supreme Council's own Dalek.

The $(thing)Shardwarden$() guards these halls: a floating core of time-crystal in a gold halo, with four crystal plates circling it. It keeps its distance and fires $(item)Temporal Shards$() that slow whatever they hit. Hurt it and it may blink away through time.
pages.title: Shardwarden

pages.text: The rarest finds in a Gallifreyan Vault: the $(item)Citadel$() armour trim, with circlet, collar and roundel, and the $(item)Roundel$() banner pattern. Copy the template with seven diamonds and a block of quartz.
